generationPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept game asset, transparent world sprite preview. Image 1 role: style and exact material/color identity reference only; remove all cyan arrows from the world object. Content ID / role: SKILL-008, ricochet disk projectile/world object. Intended use: a single disk redirected between enemies by Unity and spinning in flight; must read at roughly 26–38 screen pixels. View/composition: square master, isolated object, 3/4 top-down gameplay view, centered pivot, compact near-circular thick throwing disk shown at a shallow readable angle, fills about 64% of canvas, even transparent padding for rotation. Style: stylized 2D storybook cutout, hand-drawn, chunky, strong silhouette; thick slightly irregular deep-plum outer contour near #241B2B; flat matte steel outer body, muted bronze ring, large amber center; simple cel shading, one broad highlight, subtle dry-brush texture. Design: smooth blunt outer rim with three short cyan enamel rebound notches embedded into the rim; clearly a ricochet disk, not a saw blade, not a shield, not a coin. No external arrows. Output: genuinely transparent background, clean RGBA alpha, no halo, no baked shadow. Avoid: teeth, sharp saw rim, motion arrows, trail, glow, speed lines, sparks, particles, ground plane, scene, frame, text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, character, hands, photorealism, 3D render, pixel art, tiny ornament, cropped edges.
